title: Proposed $24,000 base fee - bottom-up economics
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC / PROPOSED. Every hour figure and every rate below is an ASSUMPTION for modelling, not an agreed or observed figure. No University of Iowa data appears here. The $24,000 base, $4,000 option and 40/40/20 milestone split are the proposed commercial facts; everything else is a working estimate.

production.label: Production (analysis, build, evidence work)
production.note: Illustrative loaded rate. NOT an agreed rate card. Chosen to match the $70/$85 pair already used in the readout-option model so the two are comparable; it is not evidence that either is correct.

review.label: Senior review and professional judgement
review.note: Illustrative loaded rate for senior time. NOT an agreed rate card.

admin.label: Administration and coordination
admin.note: Illustrative loaded rate for coordination time. NOT an agreed rate card.

overheads._note: Both are proposed assumptions. Admin overhead covers non-billed coordination load; contingency covers re-work not already carried in correction_hours.

packages.name: Evidence organization and intake
packages.description: Receive, register and version the supplied evidence; build the evidence register and source locators.

packages.name: Assessment matrix population
packages.description: Populate the twelve-cell matrix from the registered evidence, with unassessed and insufficient-evidence cells kept distinct.

packages.name: Findings and traceability
packages.description: Draft findings, bind each to its exact source version and locator, and build the traceability appendix.

packages.name: Report production
packages.description: Assemble the report: structure, cross-cutting themes, visuals, recommendations and the phased roadmap.

packages.name: Consolidated review and corrections
packages.description: Take one consolidated set of University comments through disposition and produce the corrected report.
packages._UNKNOWN_NOTE: DELIBERATE UNKNOWN, and a realistic one. correction_hours is null in every case because the correction workload depends on the volume of consolidated comments, which is unknown until the draft is reviewed. It is NOT zero. A zero here would inflate margin, which is exactly the error this model refuses to make.
